name: Frontier Rifle
description: Balanced colony rifle: +2 accuracy and +1 damage without changing weapon handling.

name: Mire LMG
description: Heavy sustained fire trades 2 accuracy for 2 additional damage.

name: Service Pistol
description: Reliable sidearm that preserves the wielder's baseline combat profile.

name: Breach Scattergun
description: Range 3 breach weapon: -8 accuracy but +3 damage for punching through armour up close.

name: Needle Carbine
description: One-AP mobile weapon at range 6, trading 6 accuracy and 2 damage for repeated fire.

name: Survey Harness
description: Adds 1 accuracy and can Mark a hostile with Disrupted once per operation.

name: Chitin Plate
description: Adds 1 armour and 1 vitality without reducing movement.

name: Field Medkit
description: Adds 1 vitality and restores 5 vitality to an ally once per operation.

name: Field Toolkit
description: Adds 1 accuracy and grants an ally Guarded once per operation.

name: Mireborn Sense
description: Sedge reads a hostile hazard line, disrupting that hostile and bracing the courier once per operation.

name: Severed Resonance
description: Ninth's borrowed phrase hinders one hostile and braces every colonist holding the line around it once per operation.

name: Directorate Smartlink
description: Contact prototype that adds 8 accuracy through Directorate target prediction.

name: Exile Cipher
description: Veya's stolen targeting key can scramble one hostile's movement envelope once per operation.

name: Brood Living Plate
description: Contact prototype that adds 2 armour and 2 vitality through living tissue.

name: Ascendant Phase Lens
description: Contact prototype that adds 2 accuracy and 2 damage through phase alignment.
